name: book statement link
description: Links a statement to a book in which it is made

properties.name: book id
properties.description: Id of the book where the statement appears

name: book translation
description: Represents a translated specific book of the Bible

properties.name: translation id
properties.description: Id of the translation this book is part of

name: footnote
description: Represents a foot note made within the original text, concerning a specific word or a statement within the text

properties.name: commented statement id
properties.description: Id of the specific statement this footnote comments on

properties.name: targeted word index
properties.description:
A 0-based index that specifies the word targeted within this statement. 
None if no specific word was targeted.

name: footnote statement link
description: Links a footnote to a statement made within it

properties.name: parent id
properties.description: Id of the footnote where the statement is made

name: translation
description: Represents a translation covering one or more Bible books

properties.name: abbreviation
properties.description:
A shortened version of this translation's name. 
Empty if there is no abbreviation.

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this translation was added to this database

name: verse marker
description: Locates a verse marker within a text

properties.name: chapter index
properties.description: A 1-based index that indicates which chapter this verse belongs to

properties.name: verse index
properties.description: A 1-based index that indicates which verse this is

properties.name: first statement id
properties.description: Id of the book statement that starts this verse

name: statement placement
description: Common trait for models which are used for placing statements within various texts

properties.name: parent id
properties.description: Id of the text where the placed text appears

properties.name: statement id
properties.description: Id of the statement which appears within the linked text

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text

name: text placement
description: Places some type of text to some location within another text

properties.name: parent id
properties.description: Id of the text where the placed text appears

properties.name: placed id
properties.description: Id of the text that is placed within the parent text

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text
